title: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose And INA
definition: The Indian National Army (INA) or Azad Hind Fauj was an armed force formed by Indian nationalists in 1942 in Southeast Asia, with the objective of securing Indian independence from British rule through military action, led by Subhash Chandra Bose.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a perennial favorite in UPSC Prelims (chronology, leadership, locations) and Mains (impact on British withdrawal, communal harmony, and the role of radical nationalism).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose And INA.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
